# ComBox

ComBox is a fast, private messenger that runs in the browser: chats, channels,
voice rooms, calls and file sharing. Works on desktop and mobile, with light
and dark themes and English/Russian interface.

- App: [/](/)
- Sign in / sign up: [/auth](/auth)
- Settings (account, notifications, privacy, folders, storage): [/settings](/settings)
- Machine-readable catalog: [/ai-catalog.json](/ai-catalog.json)
- Crawl rules: [/robots.txt](/robots.txt)
- PWA manifest: [/manifest.webmanifest](/manifest.webmanifest)

ComBox is a single-page app: every route above serves the same shell and
requires JavaScript. The API lives under `/api/` and is not crawlable content.
